controls.name: Realize Instances
controls.description: Convert instances into real geometry for editing or exporting.

controls.name: Floors Lit
controls.description: Percentage of lit windows on the floors.

controls.name: Ground Floor Lit
controls.description: Percentage of lit windows or doors on the ground floor.

controls.name: Light Intensity
controls.description: Controls brightness for window lights (visual only).

controls.name: Emission Strength
controls.description: Controls real emission for window lights. Set to 0 to disable emission.

controls.name: Height Min
controls.description: Minimum height for obstruction lights. Lights appear above this value.

controls.name: Amount
controls.description: Number of water tanks to instance.

controls.name: Length Offset
controls.description: Offset the stairs length by increasing or decreasing its size.

controls.name: Color
controls.description: Stairs color (only works with the default material).

controls.name: Enable Custom Group
controls.description: Use a custom group to place stairs.

controls.name: Enable Custom Group
controls.description: Use a custom group to place plain walls.
